nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I've been in this situation before. And I'm not going to let it happen again. Not tonight.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All of you stay here! I will be back in exactly one hour, you got that?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm going to find Emily.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We could totally help, Coach K.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: No, sit here. Don't move. I already made one mistake thinking you were responsible enough to make it up here together.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're seriously going to go out there?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I've already lost one daughter. I'm not going to lose another.
Coach Kessler zips up his jacket and marches down the trail.
As soon as he's gone, Hannah and Jane share a look... Jane leans close to Hannah and whispers.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: We have to do something! This is our fault!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know... Follow me.
She has failed.
If only she had trusted Cameron just a little bit more...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You may not like that she's with a guy, but the fact that Cameron's with her gives her a better chance out there.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It gives both of them a better chance.
Coach Kessler glares at Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Do you think I want to hear about how she's with some `boy` right now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you think I want to hear about how she's with some [color=#e23b3b][i]boy[/i][/color] right now?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Do you have any idea, Hannah, what it's like to be in my shoes?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No, sir.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then sit there and be quiet.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're right... She does.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I used to take her and Sara camping... I taught them how to survive out here.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You did a good job, sir. Emily's going to be all right.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She could always start a fire faster than her sister or I could.
A booming thunder shakes Coach Kessler from the moment. He holds his hand out, feeling the rain come pouring down.
His face fills with a steely resolve...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Why didn't you stick with her? Why didn't any of you stick with her?
Coach hangs his head for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She's so vulnerable.
The swimmers share sad glances with each other...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Coach, I know you're really `really` upset... But, you're forgetting...
nodes.text_bbcode: Coach, I know you're really [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] upset... But, you're forgetting...

options.label: She's got a good head on her shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: She said that we should just go on ahead without her.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She was falling back?! My daughter doesn't just fall back unless she has a very good reason to do so!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Why was she back there?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I told you not to lie to me, Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey! Relax, Coach K! Ease off her.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Don't tell me how to act, Zach. Not when it's `my` daughter in danger.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't tell me how to act, Zach. Not when it's [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] daughter in danger.

nodes.text: Coach Kessler turns back to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If you won't tell the truth, it means you're somehow responsible.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And if she's hurt in anyway, Hannah, I swear... If she's hurt...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: She was talking to Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That sounds more like the truth... At least one of you has integrity.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: They were, um, flirting together! You know, her elbows were waaaay out like--
Coach isn't listening...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Cameron...
He turns from Hannah and Jane...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Was he flirting with her? Was he trying to make a move on her?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I... I think he might have been.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It, uh... It looked like it to me. His elbows were pointing way out like--

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Never mind. Lots of flirting.
Coach Kessler's fists clench tight.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Cameron.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Phew...
Emily crouches down and crawls into the space next to Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm surprised... I thought you'd put up more of a fuss...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Having to be so close to a notorious player like me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I know you're not going to do anything.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why's that?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because somewhere out there is my dad...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oh yeah... He must be--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Stark-raving mad?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I was going to say 'upset'. But yours is probably more accurate.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I hope I'm wrong, though. I don't want him to be so worried about me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And I definitely don't want him taking his anger out on everyone else...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I'm not going to go in there next to `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, but I'm not going to go in there next to [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You think that I'm trying to make a move on you? I didn't design this cave. I can't help that it's this small.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, let's just go find another cave then.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: `You` can go find another cave. I'm staying right here at the Rocky Cave Inn.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] can go find another cave. I'm staying right here at the Rocky Cave Inn.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine! Maybe I will.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm serious, Em. I'm not leaving here to go with you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're bluffing! You wouldn't let me go off all by myself! Not out here... Not while it's getting dark!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Try me.
Emily stops to consider Cameron's sincerity for a moment. In that pause, he flashes her a wide smile.
It's enough for Emily to stick to her guns.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Bye!
She turns from him and storms away, not even bothering to look back.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Em? Where are you going? It's dangerous.
As darkness begins to fall, Emily's anger wanes and is replaced with a feeling of complete loneliness.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why did I have to be so stubborn?
After a few more steps, she stops.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess I'll swallow my pride and go back to Cameron's cave...
But when Emily turns around, she has no idea where she came from...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no...
It's not clear whether Emily will make it back to Cameron, but one thing's for sure...
Emily moves rapidly along the ledge...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Em, slow down!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm fine. I've got this under--
Emily's foot slips!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Aaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Like lightning, Cameron darts his hand out, holding Emily up.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Be careful!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sorry doesn't matter when you're gone.
Emily slows her pace, eventually making it to the other side.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Emily, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm fine, I'm just... Still rattled by what happened back there...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Any sign of the rest of the swim team?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No, and it's getting dark fast... We're going to have to spend the night here.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wow. The cave is a lot smaller than I thought it would be. I don't think both of us can fit in that small space...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I know it's not a palace, but it's all we've got.
Cameron settles down inside the cave. Emily peers inside... There's barely enough room for her.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Besides, it might be the only dry spot around here for miles.
Emily reaches the far side!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I knew you could do it!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't believe it! I made it! It feels `so` good to be...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe it! I made it! It feels [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] good to be...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: ...Alive.
Emily slides her foot cautiously forward. Ahead of her, Cameron reaches the other side.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're almost there! Just a little bit more!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Just a little bit more...
Emily takes it slow, easing her way along the ledge.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Breathe, Em, Breathe...
Nearby, a narrow ledge leads to a tiny, naturally-formed cave on the other side of the ravine.
Water runs off the top just like a roof.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I don't know, Em... This seems pretty dangerous. The rocks on this ledge are getting really wet.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, they're not going to get any drier if we stand around talking about this.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Look, seriously, if you fall, you could...
Cameron nods at the steep drop beneath the ledge.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I couldn't live with myself.
Emily looks up at him.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's not going to happen. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You promise? How can you promise that?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I promise. I'll be careful.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Fine. We'll go. But we'll go `slow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. We'll go. But we'll go [color=#e23b3b][i]slow.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily starts to head out onto the ledge, but Cameron pulls her back.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And I'll go first.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sure. Be my guest.
Cameron steps out onto the ledge, shimmying his way out. His foot collides with a small rock, knocking it off the ledge. Emily traces its path all the way down to the bottom of the ravine!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Careful.
Emily turns her body sideways and slides along the ledge a foot at a time.
The water runs in rivulets down the steep cliff face, lapping at their shoes.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay, focus, Emily. You can do this.
Emily stops just in time and narrowly avoids slamming into Cameron!
In front of them, the trail gives way, forming a steep ravine that drops hundreds of feet to the ground below!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Whoa! Glad I stopped.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Me too.
She slams into Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Emily, what are you doing?!
Cameron topples forward. Flailing his arms wildly, he manages to grab hold of a nearby branch!
It suspends him from falling over the edge...
In front of them, the trail gives way, forming a steep ravine that drops hundreds of feet to the ground below!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry!

nodes.text: Emily pulls Cameron back from the edge.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I could have fallen, Emily! Try to be more careful out here, will you?
Emily doesn't know what to do, so she keeps running forward!
He hears a faint yell coming from just up ahead.
You are now playing as Emily.
`The present...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]The present...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: ...And that's how I found you.
Emily and Cameron are now hiking through some thick woods, towards the summit. Emily walks a few steps behind Cameron.
His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard `thud!`
nodes.text_bbcode: His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard [b]thud![/b]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He slowly gets back up and dusts himself off.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: At least I didn't land on my face... `Ow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: At least I didn't land on my face... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard `thud!`

nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He slowly gets back up and dusts himself off.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: At least I didn't land on my face... `Ow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: At least I didn't land on my face... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cameron quickly turns both feet sideways like a snowboarder. He slides smoothly over the edge, nimbly landing on a flat rock below.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Phew! Thank you hot snowboard instructor from two years ago... Whatever your name was.
His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard `thud!`
nodes.text_bbcode: His fleet fly out from under him! He flies over the edge, sprawling out on the rocky ground, and landing on his back with a hard [b]thud![/b]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He slowly gets back up and dusts himself off.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: At least I didn't land on my face... `Ow.`
nodes.text_bbcode: At least I didn't land on my face... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cameron hesitates!
Cameron runs off.
He races along a bend in the trail, barely able to navigate the jagged stones beneath his feet!
He suddenly comes upon a sharp drop and he...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I find it hard to believe neither of you know where Emily is, considering she was hiking with you this whole time.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like I said, we, um, haven't seen her.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Actually, we... We did kind of...
Hannah steps hard on Jane's foot!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Er! We haven't seen her since we left!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I `know` you're lying!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you're lying!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Do you really `know` that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you really [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] that?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Grr! I'll deal with both of you later.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'd stay, but unlike the two of you, I actually care about Emily.
Emily rubs the stick back and forth along her palms, hoping to see smoke rise from the kindling at the base.
A small flame forms, and Emily blows on the tiny twigs, spreading the fire to the rest of the kindling.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come on! Start!
Emily and Cameron stare at the flame expectantly as a wind rushes through, nearly blowing it out.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Don't you dare!
`Foomp!` The flame spreads to a thicker branch, soon Emily and Cameron are huddled around a bona fide fire!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Foomp![/b] The flame spreads to a thicker branch, soon Emily and Cameron are huddled around a bona fide fire!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Woohoo!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You did it, Em! That was like watching a nature channel special or something!
Emily and Cameron spend the next few minutes getting warm and chatting.
But it doesn't last. Eventually, the fire dies out.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: At least we were warm for a while.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: True... Until now, I don't know if I've ever really appreciated the thermostat in my house.

nodes.text: Zach steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It was my fault too. I let Emily fall behind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And mine too.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And mine.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was my fault too.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It was... It was my fault... That's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It was my fault too.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I mean... I'm sorry.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It was my fault!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Emily? What are you...?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Just `trust` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just [color=#3b78e2][i]trust[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Your fault?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I stayed back because I was feeling excluded from the team.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It was stupid of me.
Emily gives Hannah and Jane a quick look.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because I had isolated myself, I got stuck...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Cameron came back for me.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Is that true?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then I owe you one. I'm sorry.
Emily can't summon the courage to interrupt Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It was...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It was my fault. You're right, but not in the way you think.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Don't you presume to know what I'm thinking.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I think that you think I was trying to take advantage of your daughter.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Be very careful with how you phrase your next few sentences, young man.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm not interested in Emily like that.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then how is this your fault?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I let Emily fall behind. That's not how a team is supposed to work...
An alarm goes off on Jane's phone.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: We've gotta get back.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can only imagine what my dad must be going through.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And I can only imagine how he reacted when he found out you two abandoned Emily!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: He, uh, really flipped out! That was definitely his reaction!
Hannah nudges Jane, and the four of them head toward the summit.
At the summit, Emily, Cameron, Hannah, and Jane arrive...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hannah's back! And the rest of them too!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! More people I know!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Took you guys long enough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is everyone in one piece?
Emily nods at Jane as she limps along.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: For the most part.
Across the way, Emily locks eyes with her father.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Emily!
He runs over and pulls her in for a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I... I don't know what I would have done...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm okay, Dad.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I know, but...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm just glad you're all right.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: She was a real trooper. All the way. You raised one heck of a--
Cameron's words are cut short by a look from Coach Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Don't talk to me about my daughter!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Dad!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: This is `your` fault, young man!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] fault, young man!

nodes.text: Emily sees Cameron eying Hannah and Jane.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: He's going to tell on them!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It was--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's what this whole trip has been about, hasn't it?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We don't always like each, but when the chips are down, isn't being there what matters most?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It is. I... I can't thank you enough, Emily.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So you just did it because you're `that` good, is that it?
nodes.text_bbcode: So you just did it because you're [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] good, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I didn't realize how stuck-up you were until now. We can't all be perfect, you know.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, `I` saved `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] saved [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Why don't you rub your greatness in my face a little more?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because, uh...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Because she had to!
Hannah closes her eyes and lets go! She falls through the air...
...Right into Emily's arms!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You caught me!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What did you think was going to happen?
A moment later, Cameron shows up with Jane in his arms.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: She hurt her ankle, and then wandered off to try and find help.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Ow. It's still tender... I guess I'm only an Amazon in spirit.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come on, let's try to get out of the rain as much as we can.
Soon after, the four of them find cover from the rain underneath a thick canopy of trees.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What happened to you two? Where are the others?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We felt bad about what we did, so we came looking for you. Jane and I were up on that ridge over there when we got caught in this mudslide.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It tossed us over the edge, and that's how Jane messed up her ankle.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks for helping us.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah...
The word hangs there for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: 'Yeah'? 'Yeah'?! That's all you have to say!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: She just saved you! And all you can say is `yeah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: She just saved you! And all you can say is [color=#e23b3b][i]yeah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I guess I'm a little speechless.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I just can't believe she caught me. I... I don't know that I would have done the same if she had been the one to abandon me.
Hannah turns to Emily.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I treated you like dirt, and you had every opportunity to make me pay for it. Why did you help me?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't get me wrong, I'm still `really` mad... At both of you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't get me wrong, I'm still [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] mad... At both of you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But I helped you because...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The situation is what it is, Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That's exactly what I would say right before I let you fall!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You don't have a choice! Come down!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No! I'm never coming down!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine! Then I'm leaving you!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait! Don't go!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you going to fall?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Maybe... It's a long way down.
Hannah scoots her feet a little bit closer to the edge.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Couldn't you at least say something nice?

nodes.text: So... I was in trouble, and you stopped to accuse Hannah and Jane?

nodes.text: You could look at it that way...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know what way that it is.

nodes.text: Hey, I'm sorry.

nodes.text: It's okay, Cameron.

nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.text: How do you know this is the way to go?

nodes.text: Because I'm an expert tracker. Before Twin Branches, I worked with my father as a fur trapper.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Too easy, Kessler. It's too easy with you.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I mean, come on, a fur trapper? Does that even exist anymore?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Har har. I'm `still` mad at you, you know.
nodes.text_bbcode: Har har. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] mad at you, you know.

nodes.text: I know... I'm heading this way because we might be able to find some cover under these big boulders.

nodes.text: It was my fault too, Coach. I shouldn't have fallen behind.

nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That was quite an awesome display of team chemistry.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It wasn't what I envisioned when I planned this trip...

nodes.text: But it will do. Everyone, bring it in.

nodes.text: So... Do you guys want to stay for one more day? I promise... No more challenges. Just fun and relaxation!

Back at Twin Branches...
Ben and Owen are walking down the hall toward the parking lot...
I don't know if you know this feeling...
But Emily comes back today! I want to kiss the first thing I see!
Uh...
Owen steps a little bit farther away from Ben.
I know the feeling. But it's been a while...
I'm guessing the flowers you're holding are for her?
Detective score up, Owen!
Heh.
So, what are you doing now that football's over with?
I've been asking myself the same question.
Every year at about this time, Spencer experiences this weird football withdrawal thing...
Last year, I caught him turning down a date with a cheerleader because he 'had to tackle something!'
Heh. When that happens, you've got it bad.
That's not even the worst part. The next day I saw him running across the field tackling a dummy he'd made out of paper mache.
He even named it. Football Face.
Wow.
So... No more football. What does Mystery Man do when he's not, you know, footballing?
Actually, I'm really looking forward to this Psychology class.
You're not taking Finances? It's supposed to be like the most entertaining class in the school.
Mrs. Fitzpootie let the cheerleaders turn the classroom into a club for their business project!
I heard it was a fun class, but I decided against it because... Well, I just did.
But... Cheerleader dance party... At school!
I have my reasons, okay?
Got it. Mystery man wants to keep the mystery. But just know... You're like the only person in Psych.
Not the `only` person.
Paige walks past the guys...
Not `all` the cool people are in Finances, Ben. Owen here made big strides last week, didn't you, Owen?
Stepped out from little Miss Croissant Hair's thumb--
Uh...
She means $ZOE.
Oh, I know. I'm just hungry now.
Owen here chose an elective she's not taking. You must really like her if you're avoiding her this much, huh?
Hey, I chose Psych because I'm interested in it.
Sure you are! Gotta go!
Paige sashays off.
If I had known she was going to torment me this much, I wouldn't have signed up.
Seems unfair, doesn't it? Like a French kid in the French class...
You've got a psycho in Psych class.
That was awful.
They reach the end of the hall, where they part ways.
Catch ya later. Try not to pass up any dates.
I don't know... Must. Tackle. Must. Tackle.
Owen walks away. Ben checks his phone.
Hmmm... No texts from Emily...
Ben steps outside...
...And sees that the bus has already arrived!
Ben runs down the steps, looking for Emily...
...But stops when he sees her and Cameron together!
Emily rests her head on Cameron's shoulder, and he puts his arm around her, giving her a playful squeeze!
He stares at the flowers in his hand, sighs, and walks toward Emily and Cameron...

nodes.text: On the way to a swim team retreat, Emily inadvertently made Hannah and Jane jealous by talking to Cameron.
They responded by abandoning Emily on the trail during a team-building hike to the top of Mount Collins!
Cameron came back for Emily, and the two of them headed for the mountaintop together. Along the way, Cameron promised to explain his odd behavior, but before he could...
They discovered that they were lost!

nodes.title: Swim Team Retreat, Part 2
nodes.subtitle: Will Emily and Cameron survive in the wild?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't believe this... How'd we end up so lost?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Must have made a wrong turn. We want to be over there.
Cameron points to a peak off in the distance. Dark storm clouds gather at the top.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's probably where the rest of the team is.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Em, don't worry.
He reaches over and tenderly moves a strand of hair out of her face.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: We're going to be okay.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey! What did I say about flirting with me?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: How is that flirting? All I did was move your hair.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, and all you did was sit next to me on the bus, `rescue me,` and then stare deeply into my eyes like you're some hot, weird, creeper!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and all you did was sit next to me on the bus, [color=#3b78e2][i]rescue me,[/i][/color] and then stare deeply into my eyes like you're some hot, weird, creeper!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So you think I'm hot?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Not funny. When are you going to tell me what's going on with you?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Later. Now's not the time. Right now, we need to head towards the summit.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine. You sure the team's there?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Based on when I last saw them, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And when was that?
You are now playing as Cameron.
Several hours ago...
Cameron is hiking up the trail toward the summit. Sam and Amanda are ahead of him, barely within earshot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're making pretty good time, don't you think, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You can `make` time?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can [color=#3b78e2][i]make[/i][/color] time?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wish. If we could, I'd make it tomorrow.
Cameron glances behind him expectantly... But he doesn't see anyone.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's funny, I thought Hannah, Jane, and Emily were `right` behind me...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's funny, I thought Hannah, Jane, and Emily were [color=#e23b3b][i]right[/i][/color] behind me...

nodes.text: He turns and runs back down the trail...
After a moment, he spots Hannah and Jane hiking up.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hannah! Jane! Are you two okay?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, we're fine now that you're here.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Don't be so forward, Hannah. You look pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Have you seen Emily?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Uhhhh...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: She `was` right behind us, but I thought she passed us.
nodes.text_bbcode: She [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] right behind us, but I thought she passed us.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're sure she's not ahead of you? I just assumed since she kind of has that reputation for hanging around guys...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Actually, I have no idea what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, um, she's always giving off strong, flirtatious signals! You know, gawking or rubbing her face or pointing her elbows out like a chicken.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh, wow. That really explains your problems with guys.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Okay, maybe I don't know what flirting is!
